notes: Consumed by harness/parse_drc_log.py --waivers. A waiver does not delete a finding: it
moves it into a waived bucket that is printed and counted. A waiver matching nothing is
reported as STALE and turns the run RED, so this register cannot silently rot.
Every entry needs kind, match (literal or regex), reason and authority. 'match' is tested
against the individual ITEM (a pin like J7-ESP.B8, a designator, a net name), not the
whole log line, so a batched Warn covering 30 pins can be waived one pin at a time.
Do NOT add a waiver to make a count look better. Adding one is a design statement that the
finding is intentional, and it is signed.

waivers.reason: USB-C SBU1/SBU2 on the ESP32-S3 service port are intentionally unconnected. This port carries USB 2.0 data and power for service and recovery only; no alternate mode, no debug accessory mode and no analogue audio accessory is supported on K1-CORE-VAL-R0, so SBU1/SBU2 have no defined function to route to.
waivers.authority: contracts/usb-interface.md — confirm before extending this waiver to any other USB connector
